description: Get one block's details by its id from search_blocks: what it is, its install command, the npm packages and registry items it depends on, the files it adds, and its registry's notes on using it. Set include_source to also get its source code, for when the user wants to read or adapt the code rather than install it.

id.description: The block's id from search_blocks, as registry/name, such as efferd/hero-1. Its page's address works too.

include_source.description: Also give the source of its files. It can be long, and installing the block adds the files anyway.

name: get_block
title: Get a shadcn/ui block
